name: Hod
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Hod was a man from the tribe of Asher, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Shomer and belonged to a lineage of tribal leaders and skilled warriors. His significance lies in his place in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher as part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Hod is listed as one of the sons of Shomer in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher, among tribal leaders and skilled warriors.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Hod belonged to the tribe of Asher, one of the twelve tribes of Israel. The descendants of Asher were regarded as skilled warriors and tribal leaders.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Shomer
keyEvents.description: Somer, the father of Hod, had several sons who were all counted among Asher's prominent families and heads.

keyEvents.title: Asher's Warriors Counted
keyEvents.description: The men of the tribe of Asher were registered as fit for war and as heads of their clans. The number was counted at 26,000 warriors.
